svg.aria-label: About me: I build production-minded AI systems: LLM and retrieval apps, evaluation and observability tools, and deep learning for medical signals. Most recently: ML Engineer Intern at Aventusoft (2025–26): ECG deep learning for arrhythmia classification and PQRST detection, shipped to TensorFlow Lite and AWS SageMaker. Now building: LeaveNow, a real-time bus planner for Gainesville; LLM observability (Spanscope); RAG over codebases (CodeAtlas); and offline voice control (SayWatt). Learning: LLM inference and serving, Model Context Protocol, and event-driven systems at scale. Ask me about: ECG signals, medical imaging, RAG and search, LLM evaluation, and deploying models to cloud and edge. Fun fact: From automating 120+ Salesforce test workflows to AI that detects heart conditions with 94% accuracy.
